verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs and a documented deprecation policy are a fair thing to ask of a payments API platform, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, version headers, changelogs or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path tried. With no evidence for an applicable capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
